name: dtc-ingestion
description: Ingestion and modelling layer for direct-to-consumer brands: orders, email events, ad spend and refunds, for any number of tenants, into Postgres.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.demo: npm run db:reset && npm run migrate && npm run ingest -- --tenant northwind --batches 1-4 && npm run ingest -- --tenant northwind && (npm run ingest -- --tenant lumen --crash-after-rows 500 || true) && npm run ingest -- --tenant lumen && npm run ingest -- --tenant acme
scripts.check:deliveries: npm run --workspace packages/pipeline --silent dtc -- check deliveries
scripts.check:finance: npm run --workspace packages/pipeline --silent dtc -- check finance
scripts.check:freshness: npm run --workspace packages/pipeline --silent dtc -- check freshness
